title: Boston Birth Cohort Study
official: Early Life Origins of Pediatric and Adult Diseases: Boston Birth Cohort Study
summary: Early life exposures may lead to adverse effects on health in later life. The Boston birth Cohort study is designed to study a broad array of early life factors and their effects on maternal and child health outcomes across the life course.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mothers who deliver singleton live births at Boston Medical Center are eligible for the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancies that are a result of in vitro fertilization or that involve multiple gestations, fetal chromosomal abnormalities or major birth defects.
sponsor: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
